title: webODV Oxygen Significance Analysis
description: R software for a Welch t-test sensitivity analysis accounting approximately for temporal autocorrelation. Includes two small dissolved oxygen data subsets (1999–2000 and 2019–2020) originating from the Hawaii Ocean Time-series (HOT) program and exported via HOT-webODV. The MIT license applies to the original R code only; observational data remain subject to the original HOT provider's terms and attribution requests. See DATA_LICENSE.md for provenance and reuse notes.
